notes: Kohl's Home (kohls.com) - New Arrivals investigation. ACCESS: same tier progression as bs196.json/cl196.json - tier1 curl_cffi got sitemaps but only Akamai behavioral-challenge shells for catalog pages; tier2 plain Playwright chromium hard 403'd; tier3 Claude-in-Chrome (real connected browser) cleared the behavioral challenge after ~6-8s per fresh nav and rendered real content, used for every page below. robots.txt (live, no Claude-specific disallow) checked first. NAVIGATION: sitemap_catalog_N.xml/sitemap_trend.xml grep for 'new-arriv' literal URL slugs returned nothing, but the same sitemaps revealed a genuine 'Assortment:New Arrivals' facet (e.g. shoes.jsp?CN=Department:Shoes+Assortment:New Arrivals) and, specifically for Home, 'for-the-home.jsp?CN=Activity:For the Home+Assortment:New Arrivals' - opened live and confirmed a real, large, paginated (30 pages) product grid titled 'New Arrivals For the Home (3,545)', which is the site's own Home-scoped New Arrivals concept (distinct from the site-wide catalog.jsp?CN=Assortment:New Arrivals, which spans all departments and was not used). Unlike the Clearance concept, this Home New Arrivals page is NOT a links-only hub - it is itself a genuine PLP with real products, so it is recorded as its own leaf row, not a grouping row. To check for genuine department-level children analogous to the Clearance hub's structure, the same Assortment:New Arrivals facet was combined directly with each Home department: Home Decor (2,693 items, a different, smaller, genuinely distinct listing from the 3,545 aggregate - both kept per the 'different counts = different listings' rule), Furniture (72), Kitchen & Dining (359), Bedding+Bath (293, page displayed as 'Bedding (293)' though the Department filter chip showed both Bath and Bedding), and Lighting (0 items - dropped per the zero-listing rule). These per-department counts do not sum exactly to the 3,545 aggregate (2693+72+359+0+293=3417); the ~128 item gap is most likely items tagged Assortment:New Arrivals + Activity:For the Home but carrying a Department outside the 5 checked (e.g. Patio & Garden, or an untagged Department) - not a scoping error on this pass. All qty values are the site's own on-page heading/'Show N Items' count read directly off the rendered PLP after the Akamai challenge cleared.
